name: QuestionnaireEnablePredicate
title: Questionnaire enable predicate
description: On an enableWhen (or open-pedigree's disabledWhen) condition: the condition tests a named pedigree predicate instead of another item's answer. Predicates: `isFetus`; `hasRelationships`; `isProband`; `isRelatedToProband`; `hasToBeAdopted`; `isTwin`; `isTwinWithConsistentGender`; `canLinkPatient`; `canImportClinicalData`; `canLinkRecord`; `canCreateNewRecord`; `canEditLinkedRecord`. A sibling `negate` on the condition inverts it.
